rationale: A unanimous reversal is most likely written by the Chief Justice (or, secondarily, Justice Kagan) to emphasize contextual statutory construction, Morissette-style borrowing of criminal-law terms, and overbreadth as "strong medicine". The most plausible separate writings are concurrences (Thomas/Gorsuch/Alito/Jackson) to stress originalist/textualist foundations, mens rea and enforcement-limiting cautions, or to flag as-applied/chilling-effect concerns while joining the narrowing construction.
